confirmedFindings.title: Backup mutations bypass the existing historical-mode write guard
confirmedFindings.mechanism: All six backup mutations omit requiresLiveMode. request defaults that flag false, and assertOperationalWriteAllowed returns without checking as_of/offline for a non-opted-in write. Backup routes are also absent from the immediate offline unsafe-write patterns. Portable settings Apply correctly opts in, but the surrounding backup actions do not.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: In a future authorized synthetic test, use an online /backup?as_of=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z environment, intercept request without network and activate Quick backup or save/delete/trigger/verify. Inspect that these options do not invoke the live-only gate. Never run an actual backup to demonstrate it.
confirmedFindings.needs: One narrow page action-guard fix: use the existing live-only mutation contract and visible read-only reasons, preserving route methods, cancellation, sudo and payloads; add covering synthetic tests under a separately assigned source/test claim.

confirmedFindings.title: Required provider inputs and integer/server bounds are bypassed by click-save
confirmedFindings.mechanism: The modal body is a div, not a validated form submit. Save is disabled only for blank name; handleSave immediately mutates form. required attributes now exist but cannot stop that click callback. Frequency/retention enforce only Math.max(1, Number(value)); there is no finite integer or upper-bound validation, while the server clamps frequency to 30 and retention to 100.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future synthetic seam test: create a named S3 config with all mandatory provider fields blank, click Create and assert no request should occur; current source calls mutate. Enter 1.5 or 31 frequency: source sends it without field feedback, whereas the Go integer decoder rejects a fraction or bounds clamp changes 31 to 30.
confirmedFindings.needs: One validated config-submit fix with localized field errors/summary and server-consistent finite integer bounds; retain stable IDs, native requirements and password/textarea credential types.

confirmedFindings.title: Integrity UI conflates no checksum and verification service errors with corruption
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Successful preview without a stored checksum returns checksum_verified=false but means no comparison was performed; page prints Checksum verification failed in danger styling. VerifyBackup serializes every processor error as verified=false plus error, including no file/checksum/provider/download errors. The page ignores error and prints Checksum mismatch; an empty 204 body also falls into that same mismatch branch.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Use synthetic preview {tables:[],metadata:null,checksum_verified:false} for an absent-checksum run; current render claims failure. Return {verified:false,error:'backup has no file path or checksum'} or undefined to the verify seam; current toast claims mismatch. Actual verified=true preview is NOT falsely accused: RestoreBackup performs the comparison first.
confirmedFindings.needs: One integrity-evidence presentation correction: neutral not-verified/unknown for absent evidence, distinct unavailable/error versus proven mismatch, retain true-success comparison and existing standalone verification.

confirmedFindings.title: Recent-errors success message can contradict an observed failed run
confirmedFindings.mechanism: failedRuns drops status=failed rows whose optional error_message is absent/empty. When all failures lack text, failedCount is positive but failedRuns.length is zero and a success callout says No recent backup failures.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future source-render test with one synthetic failed run and error_message=null yields Failed runs=1 alongside No recent backup failures. No backend fault is needed.
confirmedFindings.needs: One recent-failures truthfulness fix: retain failed rows regardless of message, use localized missing-detail copy and accurate returned-list scope.

confirmedFindings.title: Backup history offers only client pagination of the first 50 server rows
confirmedFindings.mechanism: ListRuns defaults limit=50 offset=0. The query sends no bounds, and the table gets only the returned array with local pagination, so no page action asks for row 51 or older. Summary honestly discloses list coverage, but full history navigation is inaccessible.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future synthetic endpoint fixture containing 51 ordered runs: initial page receives 50; changing local table pages issues no offset request and cannot expose the oldest completed snapshot for download/preview.
confirmedFindings.needs: One bounded history-coverage/paging item using the existing limit/offset contract; retain source order, loaded versus full-result distinctions and unknown server totals. Do not invent an aggregate total.

confirmedFindings.title: A prior save can discard a newly opened config form
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Create/update pending disables Save only. Cancel, shared modal dismissal and New config remain available. Both mutation successes call unconditional closeModal, resetting whichever session is now open rather than the submitted one.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future synthetic deferred-request test: submit config A, cancel/dismiss while pending, open New config B and type a draft, then resolve A. A's onSuccess closes/reset B and loses its unsaved draft.
confirmedFindings.needs: One config-modal pending/session-ownership fix: either prevent all pending dismissal/reopen paths through existing contracts or generation-check completion before closing a specific form.

confirmedFindings.title: Portable import preview can describe a different bundle from the one Apply sends
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Drag/drop remains active while stage=parsing, despite the picker button being disabled. Multiple ingestFile/dry-run operations have no generation/cancellation guard. A stale dry-run sets previewResult/stage but does not restore its own pending bundle. Also Change file remains enabled during Apply; an old apply completion can replace a newer import UI with applied state.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future no-network deferred seam test: drop A, let its dry-run wait; drop B and resolve B first, then A. pending remains B but A's counts become the displayed preview; Apply sends B. Separately start Apply A, use Change file to load B, then resolve A and observe the newer session overwritten.
confirmedFindings.needs: One imported-component operation-generation/busy-ownership fix, including drop intake and Change file; preserve dry-run/apply payload, explicit live-only Apply, sudo cancellation and error recovery.

confirmedFindings.title: Dynamic labels and validator failures fall back to untranslated English/raw enums
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Canonical backup.provider/status/runType are scalar header labels, not dictionaries, and backup.field is absent. Dynamic leaf keys used for provider/status/run-type/credential labels are therefore missing despite static key coverage. The schema utility returns English validation strings and the component displays them directly rather than translating an error code.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future synthetic non-English render: select S3 and inspect credential labels or run status; missing dynamic catalog leaves rely on English/raw fallbacks. Upload a synthetic object with invalid schema_version and the validator's English sentence becomes the visible error.
confirmedFindings.needs: One scoped localization item with serialized canonical catalog ownership: use noncolliding leaf families or existing mappings and localized schema error codes/interpolation. No catalog edit was made by this QA worker.

confirmedFindings.title: Empty-history Quick backup allows repeated requests while already pending
confirmedFindings.mechanism: Header Quick backup binds isPending, but runsEmpty supplies only an onClick that always mutates. Shared EmptyState renders that callback without pending/disabled props. Until the successful invalidation populates a run, the empty CTA remains repeatedly actionable.
confirmedFindings.sourceDerivedReproduction: Future no-network test with empty runs and a deferred quick mutation: activate the empty-state Quick backup twice before resolving. Both callbacks invoke mutate, unlike the disabled header button.
confirmedFindings.needs: One pending-safe empty-state backup CTA fix using a guarded page callback or an existing busy-capable composition, preserving explanatory empty content.
